children: of $350M in 0% convertible senior notes due 2032 in a private placement to qualified institutional buyers.
The transaction is scheduled to settle on September 28, 2026.
Voyager has also granted the initial purchasers a 13-day option to buy up to an additional $52.5M aggregate principal amount of notes.
The senior, unsecured notes will not bear regular interest or accrete in principal, maturing on October 15, 2032.
The initial conversion rate is set at 24.4978 shares of Class A common stock per $1,000 principal amount of notes, representing an initial conversion price of approximately $40.82 per share.
This conversion price reflects a 30% premium over Voyager’s Class A common stock closing price of $31.40 on September 23, 2026.
Voyager estimates net proceeds from the offering will total approximately $340.4M (or $391.6M if the initial purchasers' option is exercised in full) after deducting discounts and offering expenses.

Voyager plans to deploy the net proceeds primarily toward funding $45.7M in privately negotiated capped call transactions, featuring an initial cap price of $78.50 per share, a 150% premium over its September 23 close, to mitigate potential equity dilution upon conversion.
The company will allocate the remaining funds toward general corporate purposes, specifically driving organic expansion initiatives and executing strategic acquisitions.

title: Voyager Technologies prices $350M convertible senior notes offering
